children: James Feuille, a director, reported selling 25,000 shares of Chime Financial Class A Common Stock through Crosslink Crossover Fund VI, L.P. at a weighted average price of $31.16 on November 19, 2026; 25,000 shares through the fund at a weighted average price of $30.33 on November 20; and 25,000 shares through the fund at a weighted average price of $31.68 on November 23. The total sale amount was $2,329,250. Feuille is a managing member of the fund’s general partner, and disclaims beneficial ownership of the fund’s shares except to the extent of his pecuniary interest. Following the transactions, he directly owned 23,315 shares and indirectly owned 6,325,607 shares through Crosslink Crossover Fund VI, L.P., 7,949,067 through Crosslink Ventures VII, L.P., 3,405,896 through Crosslink Ventures VII-B, L.P., 842,661 through Crosslink Bayview VII, LLC, 62,000 through Crosslink Ventures VII Holdings, LLC, 162,293 through an irrevocable trust, and 45,246 through a revocable trust.
